claims.claim: Niruthi says its satellite and ground-data approach is derived from NASA TOPS, the Terrestrial Observation and Prediction System.
claims.evidence_text: Niruthi says its satellite and ground-data approach is derived from NASA TOPS, the Terrestrial Observation and Prediction System.

claims.claim: NASA Earthdata describes TOPS as combining ecosystem simulations with satellite measurements and surface weather observations to generate ecosystem nowcasts and forecasts. Its program page lists Ramakrishna Nemani as Principal Investigator at NASA Ames Research Center and places deployment at NASA Earth Exchange. Applications discussed include natural-resource management, public health and disaster management.
claims.evidence_text: NASA Earthdata describes TOPS as combining ecosystem simulations with satellite measurements and surface weather observations to generate ecosystem nowcasts and forecasts. Its program page lists Ramakrishna Nemani as Principal Investigator at NASA Ames Research Center and places deployment at NASA Earth Exchange. Applications discussed include natural-resource management, public health and disaster management.

claims.claim: The NASA page does not reference Niruthi. It explains a research system, while Niruthi supplies the commercial-technology linkage. The source does not establish NASA endorsement of Niruthi, employment today or a license agreement.
claims.evidence_text: The NASA page does not reference Niruthi. It explains a research system, while Niruthi supplies the commercial-technology linkage. The source does not establish NASA endorsement of Niruthi, employment today or a license agreement.

claims.claim: The World Bank Group GIIF interview dated 31 August 2021 describes Niruthi as an agritech business supporting crop monitoring and yield forecasting. Interviewees were Cristina Milesi, then described as Director, and Mallikarjun Kukunuri, then described as Chief Executive. GIIF reports a Gold Award in the Data & Analytics category at the 2019 Insuretech Innovation Challenge in Mumbai. It discusses smallholder farmers, financial institutions, insurers and government agencies.

claims.claim: The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare PIB release dated 17 December 2024 describes YES-TECH, Yield Estimation System Based on Technology, under PMFBY from Kharif 2023. It refers readers to the YES-TECH manual for Technology Implementation Partners. This release does not name Niruthi. Program existence alone does not establish a Niruthi contract or empanelment.

claims.claim: Listed data categories include email, name, phone number, IP address, browser information, location, usage analytics, device sensor data, camera access and storage access. The policy describes service delivery, account management, contract performance, user contact and improvements as processing purposes. It describes sharing with providers, affiliates, partners and transaction participants, while stating that personal data is not sold or shared for advertising or tracking.
